keep_features.feature_value: High density of place/political-group proper nouns (Conservatives, Canada)
keep_features.rationale: The post contains multiple capitalized proper nouns tied to political actors and a country.

keep_features.feature_value: Explicit sexual profanity used as insult
keep_features.rationale: The original text includes the taboo term "fuck".

keep_features.feature_value: Direct insult pile-on targeting a named politician
keep_features.evidence_span: "a bastard, and a vacuous ignorant moron"
keep_features.rationale: The language uses derogatory labels rather than policy argument.

keep_features.feature_value: Climate policy / decarbonization and corporate emissions
keep_features.rationale: The post centers on climate action and emissions reduction by a company.

keep_features.feature_value: Implicit urging to reject hate/division; identity-based framing
keep_features.evidence_span: "Not MAGA hate. Our politicians want us to hate each other, not solve problems."
keep_features.rationale: The phrasing contrasts desired behavior (solve problems) with an undesired one (hate/division).

keep_features.evidence_span: "in-groups whom the law protects" ... "out-groups whom the law binds"
keep_features.rationale: The content explicitly divides groups into protected vs bound categories.
The post embeds a substantial quoted sentence as its core content.

keep_features.feature_value: Personal anecdote with informal evaluative language
keep_features.evidence_span: "I thought that W was the most idiotic and incompetent president"
keep_features.rationale: It uses colloquial, subjective insults and first-person narrative style.

remove_features.feature_value: Explicit profanity directed at immigration-related group/policy
remove_features.rationale: The post begins with a direct taboo/profane command targeting ICE.

remove_features.feature_value: Degrading insults of the president and direct attack
remove_features.rationale: The mirror uses intense, evaluative outrage language plus a hostile insult.

remove_features.feature_value: Threat/imperative escalation against government actions; retaliation framing
remove_features.rationale: The post issues an aggressive prescription/retaliation style threat tied to a property policy dispute.
The explicit policy topic is banning guns.
The post contains explicit profanity used for emphasis and insult.

remove_features.feature_value: Named geographic entities and groups (Texas, Austin) and ideological comparison (Labour)
remove_features.rationale: The text includes multiple proper nouns tied to place and political parties.

remove_features.feature_value: All-caps policy slogan and mobilization language
remove_features.rationale: The message uses emphatic all-caps text to broadcast a political demand.

remove_features.feature_value: Claims voter-right limitation linked to extreme ideology (fascism/communism)
remove_features.rationale: The mirror reframes an election-related claim as evidence of conspiratorial/ideological plot.
